items.raw_text: dbreunig/nesformer Inspired by qwenputer by Divyansh Agrawal, Drew Breunig baked a working emulator for a Nintendo Entertainment System 6502 CPU into the weights of Qwen3.5-4B. You can now play NES ROMs such as Super Mario Bros (very slowly) running inside Qwen! In a comment on Hacker News Drew reveals the Opus 5.5 prompts he used to build this system: Read this article and any relevant source code: https://divagr.com/blog/qwenputer. Then explore if you could emulate the chip and ram in a Nintendo Entertainment System (as people do today with FPGAs in MISTRs) using this technique. If so, what size model would you have to build and if you could use smaller faster ones, could you get it to be at the standard clockspeed. Followed by: I think we should build it! Just for fun. It's okay if it's not fast. We want to be able to have the weights, and a cli to run them that we can point at a ROM. Apparently Opus found and then used this collection of conformance tests for the NES CPU released 15 years ago by Christopher Pow. But to some clinical psychologists, they can represent something more sinister—a potential trigger for eating disorders. A new report suggests that the global incidence of anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa shot up between 1990 and 2023—by a whopping 71%. By 2023, there were an estimated 18.1 million people living with one of these two disorders. What’s worse is that the number is likely to be much higher than that once we factor in other eating disorders. And, disturbingly, those in the field are already starting to see GLP-1 weight-loss drugs exacerbating the issue. Cheri Levinson is a clinical psychologist at the University of Louisville in Kentucky who has specialized in eating disorders for almost 20 years. She says she’s now seeing more patients with more severe symptoms than at any other time in her career, and that many of them are misusing GLP-1s. “This is the worst I’ve seen things,” she says. Eating disorders are mental health conditions in which people’s eating behaviors impact their health. They include anorexia nervosa (defined by a fear of weight gain), bulimia nervosa (in which people binge and purge), binge eating disorder, and others. items.raw_text: How I Built the Most AI-Pilled Company in the World Don't be put off by the clickbait headline, this piece by Jacob Sansbury describing how they are building Spawn is a fascinating exploration of the bleeding edge of what's possible with agentic engineering against frontier models. Spawn is a massively multiplayer gaming environment where players can use prompts (to the in-game agent, Savi) to modify the game world. I fired it up on my phone for a few minutes and was able to prompt a castle into existence, then a dragon, then ride the dragon to fly around that castle. By Jacob's telling, Spawn is now being developed autonomously by a swarm of Fable-powered agents costing over $3 million in tokens per month ("we spend 30x payroll on AI tokens"). Our agents change the live code directly and ship to production hourly, so they read every error, bug report and metric themselves. About 60% of our work starts from a production error, a Savi bug report (Savi is the AI you build games with in Spawn), something odd in our logs, or a feature request. Savi files bugs herself. When a user hits one, or Savi hits one in the product, she files it. It goes straight to an agent that decides whether it's a real bug to fix, something we won't fix, or intentional design that needs a decision. Usually it becomes a change, delivered to that user within an hour, with a message in the same chat. items.raw_text: De nieuwe centrale bibliotheek van Essen in Duitsland opende op zaterdag 24 oktober 2026 haar deuren, met een interieur ontworpen door MVRDV en includi, in samenwerking met Meyer Architekten. Door de verhuizing naar een centrale locatie in de stad kon de verbinding tussen de bibliotheek en bezoekers opnieuw worden vormgegeven. Het gerenoveerde interieur van 10.000 m² in een voormalig winkelpand telt zes verdiepingen. De nieuwe Zentralbibliothek is opgezet als ‘derde plek’ – een toegankelijke locatie voor de inwoners van Essen. Boekenkasten en een actieve binnengevel vormen de bouwstenen van het interieur. Deze verhuizing van de bibliotheek is een belangrijk project voor de stad Essen. Van de voormalige locatie naast het station verhuist de bibliotheek naar het vroegere Boeckerhaus, een bekend warenhuis in het stadshart. Het Boeckerhaus heeft van oudsher een sterke band met boeken: tot 2017 was hier boekhandel Mayersche gevestigd. Met deze transformatie krijgt het gebouw een nieuwe functie als levendige plek voor cultuur en onderwijs in de binnenstad. Voor dit ontwerp hebben de samenwerkende bureaus gekeken naar de geschiedenis en ontwikkeling van bibliotheken door de eeuwen heen. Ooit waren bibliotheken monumentale plekken alleen toegankelijk voor de elite en later werden het openbare plekken voor een breed publiek. Elder, Shannon M. Smith, and Bryan Ricupero. This collection surfaces the work taking place across open movements and highlights how practitioners and advocates can effectively collaborate for sustainable change. Open movements all center public access and broad representation, and work to prevent the concentration of power governing information and its monetization. As general discussion of openness has narrowed to focus on areas like open science, data, access, and education, these individual communities have grown distanced from each other and, occasionally, their shared values. items.raw_text: Rijksmuseum Meermanno (Voorheen Huis van het Boek) heeft het naastgelegen pand aan de Prinsessegracht 32 in Den Haag verworven. Hiermee voegt het boekenmuseum driehonderd vierkante meter toe aan zijn vloeroppervlak. In aanloop naar het 175-jarig jubileum in 2027 werkt het museum aan een vernieuwingsplan. Deze uitbreiding is daar onderdeel van. Rijksmuseum Meermanno beheert een nationale erfgoedcollectie van zo’n 500.000 objecten, waaronder 90.000 historische boeken, vroege drukken en zeldzame middeleeuwse handschriften. De aankoop van Prinsessegracht 32 maakt de komst van een nieuw studiecentrum met een inpandig depot mogelijk. Het middelpunt van deze uitbreiding moet de Leeskamer worden, een plek waar onderzoekers, studenten en bezoekers in directe verbinding staan met het depot. Daarnaast loopt het museum in de huidige panden tegen zijn fysieke grenzen aan, met een tekort aan ruimte voor educatie en publieksfuncties. Once again, NASA is asking for ideas to rescue Hubble from certain death
items.raw_text: The Hubble Space Telescope still shines in the eyes of astronomers after 36 years in orbit, but it is not as nimble as it once was. Left alone, the observatory will plunge back into the atmosphere in the early-to-mid-2030s, closing the book on one of the most famous scientific instruments of the century. NASA last raised the orbit of Hubble in 2002, when the Space Shuttle Columbia visited the observatory for a servicing mission. The final shuttle servicing flight in 2009 did not reboost the telescope's orbit, and with the retirement of the shuttle fleet two years later, Hubble has steadily lost altitude with no way to stave off eventual destruction. The space agency released a Request For Information (RFI) on Thursday asking commercial companies for ideas on how to reboost, service, or a controlled disposal of Hubble. Responses are due November 30. Specifically, NASA is looking for information about companies' current and near-term capabilities for capturing Hubble and boosting it to an altitude of at least 373 miles (600 km), enhancing the telescope's performance, or guiding Hubble to a controlled reentry. items.title: Over 25% of people lie to get antibiotics—and their lies aren't even good
items.raw_text: A significant number of patients in the US lie to their doctors to get antibiotics they likely don't need, according to two new studies. While that may not be a startling revelation, the studies drills down on the phenomenon, finding that the lies patients tell are generally bad ones—and yet, they work almost all the time. In the two linked studies published Friday in JAMA Network Open, a team of researchers led by Alistair Thorpe at the University of Utah analyzed online survey data from over 1,000 adults. They found that over a quarter of people reported having lied to a clinician at least once to get an antibiotic prescription for themselves or a child in their care. Patients lied by either exaggerating symptoms, making up symptoms, or—most often—both. But interestingly, the lies people told to get antibiotics involved making up or exaggerating symptoms of infections that wouldn't be treated with antibiotics. For example, the most common falsehoods were symptoms associated with colds, such as fever, cough, and sore throat. That's despite the fact that colds are caused by viruses, not bacteria—which antibiotics treat. Read full article Comments

In a third-quarter earnings call Thursday , DoorDash co-founder and CEO Tony Xu responded to an analyst question by noting that "AI agents are generating several hundred orders [on DoorDash] across the time that they've been up and running." In a marked understatement, Xu called this a "very low use case" for a company that handled just shy of 1 billion orders total in the third quarter of 2026 alone. Speaking generally, Xu said he sees the potential for AI agents to be genuinely helpful for "long consideration purchases" and major decisions where agents would be "doing work on your behalf proactively in the background." items.title: Rare meteorite from Mars gives us a view into its ancient crust
items.raw_text: Crater counts tell us that most of the Martian surface is more than 3 billion years old, but pieces of Mars we have on Earth tell a different story. The three main classes of Martian meteorites—shergottites, nakhlites, and chassignites—are all 2.4 billion years old or younger. Until now, only two genuinely ancient Martian meteorites were known: Allan Hills 84001, found in Antarctica, and a jumbled rock from northwest Africa nicknamed Black Beauty. Now we have a third one. A team led by Yang Liu, a planetary scientist at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, has shown that a Martian meteorite called Teghaza 001, found in the Sahara Desert in Mali in 2022, formed at least 4.1 billion years ago. “It's very old and similar to some of the oldest rocks on Earth,” Liu says. A filtered collection “We don't fully understand why old Martian rocks are so rare on Earth," Liu said. Part of the answer may lie in how a piece of Mars gets here. It takes a large impact to launch a rock off the planet, and not every rock can survive that. “If the impact hits into loose powder, it may not get cemented to become a rock and fly off Mars' gravity,” Liu said. “So the natural impact already acts as a filter. Weak rocks do not make it off Mars.” Read full article Comments

The firm estimates that between now and 2030, there will be a shortfall of about 150 launches compared to demand from satellite operators and civil space agencies. If demand from the US military is added in—and SpaceX does not extend the Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy program to accommodate increased national security needs—the shortage could be doubled. "What we wanted to get at is to understand how severe this launch crisis is and when will it be resolved," said Caleb Henry, director of research at Quilty Space. "What we learned is that the launch crisis is more severe than we thought and that it will not go away this decade for sure, and it might not abate until sometime late in the 2030s." items.raw_text: General Motors marketed its Smart Driver system as a way for parents to monitor teen drivers or for adults to track their driving behavior. Those brokers then sold the data to insurance companies , and some drivers found that their insurance became more expensive as a result. To make matters worse, many of those drivers claimed they had no knowledge of ever agreeing to share such data for such purposes. Last year , GM and its OnStar subsidiary entered into a settlement with the FTC, prohibiting them from sharing some kinds of driver data with third parties. The settlement was finalized this January. That agreement banned the two companies from sharing geolocation data or driver behavior data for five years. At the time, GM also discontinued Smart Driver across its entire range. items.raw_text: Microsoft is beginning the rollout of a Windows 11 preview update that finally addresses a persistent power user complaint with the operating system: the right-click menu that obliterated years of muscle memory on command locations and hid others behind an additional click. The timing is notable, as the announcement comes alongside Microsoft's quarterly financial report, which showed a continued decline in the business of selling Windows licenses for new PCs. The preview update, KB5127936 , is cumulative for Windows 11 versions 26H2 and 25H2. The update will be a gradual rollout before eventually moving on to a normal rollout for all Windows 11 devices once it reaches general availability. The highlight of the new update should calm annoyed users who have spent years with custom scripts and services in an attempt to shape Windows the way they would prefer it. Users will get a "customize menu" button that controls what commands appear when they right-click their mouse. Users can toggle built-in commands such as Send To or Create Shortcut on or off, rearrange what appears on the main menu, and control which third-party extensions show up in either the main or submenus. The gripe with the right-click menu had been that Microsoft hid familiar command locations behind a top row of icons while moving other familiar commands under the "Show more options" submenu. Now, Windows users can customize the whole thing around their habits. The original Windows 11 right-click menu is a mess.

items.raw_text: Nederland kan zijn afhankelijkheid van buitenlandse technologiebedrijven verkleinen door AI-modellen te ontwikkelen voor sectoren waarin ons land internationaal sterk is. Door specialistische kennis en data te bundelen, ontstaan nieuwe kansen voor innovatie en economische groei. Maar hoe zorgen we ervoor dat deze gezamenlijke AI-technologie ook op de lange termijn toegankelijk blijft? In een nieuwe position paper pleit AIC4NL daarom voor stewardship-governance: een manier om de strategische AI-basis duurzaam te beschermen, terwijl bedrijven ruimte houden om te ondernemen en te concurreren. Niet concurreren op schaal, maar op kennis AI-modellen vormen de technologische basis van veel AI-toepassingen. Ze leren patronen en verbanden herkennen in grote hoeveelheden data en kunnen daarmee bijvoorbeeld teksten genereren, voorspellingen doen of complexe informatie analyseren. Bekende toepassingen zoals ChatGPT maken gebruik van grote, algemene AI-modellen die voor uiteenlopende taken inzetbaar zijn. De ontwikkeling van deze generieke AI-modellen wordt gedomineerd door een klein aantal internationale technologiebedrijven, die daarvoor honderden miljarden investeren in infrastructuur, rekenkracht en talent. items.title: Explosie in Israëlische fabriek en zwakke pc-markt teisteren Intel
items.raw_text: Intel verloor donderdag miljarden aan beurswaarde na een fatale fabrieksexplosie en vrij sombere prognoses. Nabeurs kelderde het aandeel Intel dat dit jaar flink in herstel was, met 20 procent. Na een explosie in zijn Israëlische fabriek waarbij twee mensen om het leven kwamen, is de productie een paar weken stilgelegd. Eind deze week is een herstart mogelijk. Maar de capaciteit is verminderd. De voorlopige oorzaak van de explosie lijkt een defecte of verkeerd functionerende gascilinder te zijn geweest tijdens het lossen van industriële gassen bij de fabriek. Onderzoekers gaan ervan uit dat de ontploffing plaatsvond terwijl een tankwagen werd aangesloten op het systeem van de fabriek. Cruciale schakel Het fabrieksongeluk gaat Intel de komende twee kwartalen naar schatting 600 miljoen dollar aan omzet kosten. Zo heeft financieel directeur David Zinsner verklaard in een gesprek met persbureau Reuters. De totale financiële schade is op dit moment nog niet te becijferen. Intel onderzoekt momenteel welke wafers na de klap nog bruikbaar zijn voor de verkoop. De getroffen fabriek in Kiryat Gat is een cruciale schakel voor Intel en produceert voornamelijk datacenterchips op het 10-nanometerproces. Bijkomend probleem is dat de productie ook last heeft van tekorten aan bepaalde materialen.
